label: first input token is 3 or x (plus weak, diffuse <DEL>-step firing)
explanation: Fires on every step t=0 whose input is the digit 3 or the letter x (dev precision 1.0, 55% of activations). These activations are moderate in size (about 0.09 of max for 3, about 0.02 for x), so they carry only about 30% of the activation mass. Weaker firing also appears when 3 or x shows up at original positions 1-3 (the rate drops with position). The largest activations (up to max) sit on the <DEL> step, mostly in short sequences (L=3-4) that start with u, 2, o or a and contain a, o or p. That component is diffuse: no simple predicate (first token, L) reaches precision above 0.25 on it, and it holds about 29% of the mass. There is also scattered low-rate firing in the copy phase. It does not fire on other tokens at t=0 or on later repeats of 3/x.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by phase (input phase: 3, x, m, l; copy phase: h, v, l, b; delimiter step: <DEL>) and the previous input (most: -, t, a, r, p, y; least: e, v, b, u); timing cues that raise it most: t=0, t=3, t=17.
